sentences.en: The Happiness Industry: How the Government and Big Business Sold Us Well-Being By William Davies ‘Happiness is the ultimate goal because it is self-evidently good. If we are asked why happiness matters we can give no further external reason. It just obviously does matter.’ This pronouncement by Richard Layard, an economist and advocate of ‘positive psychology,, summarises the beliefs of many people today.
sentences.zh: 幸福产业：政府和大企业如何向我们兜售幸福 作者：William Davies “幸福是最终目标,因为它不言而喻是好的。如果我们被问到为什么幸福很重要,我们无法给出更多的外部理由。显然,这确实很重要。”经济学家、“积极心理学”倡导者理查德·莱亚德 (Richard Layard) 的这一言论总结了当今许多人的信念。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: For Layard and others like him, it is obvious that the purpose of government is to promote a state of collective well-being.
sentences.zh: 对于莱亚德和其他像他一样的人来说,政府的目的显然是促进集体福祉。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The only question is how to achieve it, and here positive psychology - a supposed science that not only identifies what makes people happy but also allows their happiness to be measured - can show the way.
sentences.zh: 唯一的问题是如何实现这一目标,而积极心理学——一门所谓的科学,不仅可以识别什么使人们快乐,而且还可以衡量他们的幸福感——可以指明道路。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Equipped with this science, they say, governments can secure happiness in society in a way they never could in the past.
sentences.zh: 他们说,有了这门科学,政府就能以过去无法做到的方式确保社会幸福。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It is an astonishingly crude and simple-minded way of thinking, and for that very reason increasingly popular.
sentences.zh: 这是一种极其粗鲁和简单的思维方式,也正因为如此而越来越流行。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Those who think in this way are oblivious to the vast philosophical literature in which the meaning and value of happiness have been explored and questioned, and write as if nothing of any importance had been thought on the subject until it came to their attention.
sentences.zh: 那些以这种方式思考的人忽视了对幸福的意义和价值进行了探索和质疑的大量哲学文献,他们在写作时就好像在这个主题引起他们的注意之前没有考虑过任何重要的事情。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It was the philosopher Jeremy Bentham (1748—1832) who was more than anyone else responsible for the development of this way of thinking.
sentences.zh: 哲学家杰里米·边沁（Jeremy Bentham,1748—1832）对这种思维方式的发展负有最大的责任。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: For Bentham it was obvious that the human good consists of pleasure and the absence of pain.
sentences.zh: 对于边沁来说,人类的利益显然由快乐和无痛苦组成。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The Greek philosopher Aristotle may have identified happiness with self-realisation in the 4th century BC, and thinkers throughout the ages may have struggled to reconcile the pursuit of happiness with other human values, but for Bentham all this was mere metaphysics or fiction.
sentences.zh: 希腊哲学家亚里士多德可能在公元前 4 世纪就将幸福等同于自我实现,历代思想家可能都在努力调和对幸福的追求与其他人类价值观,但对边沁来说,这一切都只是形而上学或虚构。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Without knowing anything much of him or the school of moral theory he established - since they are by education and intellectual conviction illiterate in the history of ideas - our advocates of positive psychology follow in his tracks in rejecting as outmoded and irrelevant pretty much the entirety of ethical reflection on human happiness to date.
sentences.zh: 对他或他建立的道德理论学派一无所知——因为他们受过教育和智力信念,对思想史一无所知——我们的积极心理学倡导者追随他的脚步,拒绝接受迄今为止对人类幸福的全部伦理反思,认为它们已经过时且无关紧要。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But as William Davies notes in his recent book The Happiness Industry, the view that happiness is the only self-evident good is actually a way of limiting moral inquiry.
sentences.zh: 但正如威廉·戴维斯在他的新书《幸福产业》中指出的那样,幸福是唯一不言而喻的善的观点实际上是限制道德探究的一种方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: One of the virtues of this rich, lucid and arresting book is that it places the current cult of happiness in a well-defined historical framework.
sentences.zh: 这本丰富、清晰、引人入胜的书的优点之一是它将当前的幸福崇拜置于一个明确的历史框架中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Rightly, Davies begins his story with Bentham, noting that he was far more than a philosopher.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯正确地从边沁开始了他的故事,并指出他不仅仅是一位哲学家。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Davies writes, ‘Bentham’s activities were those which we might now associate with a public sector management consultant’.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯写道,“边沁的活动我们现在可能会与公共部门管理顾问联系起来”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: In the 1790s, he wrote to the Home Office suggesting that the departments of government be linked together through a set of 'conversation tubes,,and to the Bank of England with a design for a printing device that could produce unforgeable banknotes.
sentences.zh: 1790 年代,他写信给内政部,建议通过一套“对话管”将政府部门联系在一起,并写信给英格兰银行,建议设计一种可以生产不可伪造钞票的印刷设备。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: He drew up plans for a ‘frigidarium’ to keep provisions such as meat, fish, fruit and vegetables fresh.
sentences.zh: 他制定了“冷藏室”计划,以保持肉、鱼、水果和蔬菜等食品的新鲜。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: His celebrated design for a prison to be known as a ‘Panopticon,, in which prisoners would be kept in solitary confinement while being visible at all times to the guards, was very nearly adopted.
sentences.zh: 他著名的监狱设计被称为“全景敞视监狱”,囚犯将被单独监禁,同时看守随时可见,这一设计差一点就被采纳了。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: (Surprisingly, Davies does not discuss the fact that Bentham meant his Panopticon not just as a model prison but also as an instrument of control that could be applied to schools and factories.)
sentences.zh: （令人惊讶的是,戴维斯没有讨论边沁的圆形监狱不仅是一个模型监狱,而且是一种可以应用于学校和工厂的控制工具。）

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Bentham was also a pioneer of the ‘science of happiness’.
sentences.zh: 边沁也是“幸福科学”的先驱。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: If happiness is to be regarded as a science, it has to be measured, and Bentham suggested two ways in which this might be done.
sentences.zh: 如果幸福被视为一门科学,就必须对其进行衡量,边沁提出了两种实现这一目标的方法。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Viewing happiness as a complex of pleasurable sensations, he suggested that it might be quantified by measuring the human pulse rate.
sentences.zh: 将幸福视为愉悦感觉的综合体,他建议可以通过测量人体脉搏率来量化幸福。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Alternatively, money could be used as the standard for quantification: if two different goods have the same price, it can be claimed that they produce the same quantity of pleasure in the consumer.
sentences.zh: 或者,金钱可以作为量化的标准：如果两种不同的商品具有相同的价格,则可以声称它们给消费者带来了相同数量的快乐。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Bentham was more attracted by the latter measure.
sentences.zh: 边沁更被后一种措施所吸引。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: By associating money so closely to inner experience, Davies writes, Bentham 4set the stage for the entangling of psychological research and capitalism that would shape the business practices of the twentieth century,• The Happiness Industry describes how the project of a science of happiness has become integral to capitalism.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯写道,通过将金钱与内心体验如此紧密地联系在一起,边沁4为心理学研究和资本主义的纠缠奠定了基础,这将塑造二十世纪的商业实践。幸福产业描述了幸福科学的项目如何成为资本主义不可或缺的一部分。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: We learn much that is interesting about how economic problems are being redefined and treated as psychological maladies.
sentences.zh: 我们学到了很多关于经济问题如何被重新定义并被视为心理疾病的有趣知识。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In addition, Davies shows how the belief that inner states of pleasure and displeasure can be objectively measured has informed management studies and advertising.
sentences.zh: 此外,戴维斯还展示了可以客观衡量内心的快乐和不快状态的信念如何为管理研究和广告提供信息。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The tendency of thinkers such as J B Watson, the founder of behaviourism*, was that human beings could be shaped, or manipulated, by policymakers and managers.
sentences.zh: 行为主义*创始人 J B Watson 等思想家的倾向是,人类可以被政策制定者和管理者塑造或操纵。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Watson had no factual basis for his view of human action.
sentences.zh: 沃森对人类行为的看法没有事实依据。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: When he became president of the American Psychological Association in 1915, he 'had never even studied a single human being’： his research had been confined to experiments on white rats.
sentences.zh: 1915年,当他成为美国心理学会主席时,他“甚至从未研究过任何一个人”：他的研究仅限于白鼠实验。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Yet Watson’s reductive model is now widely applied, with 'behaviour change’ becoming the goal of governments: in Britain, a ‘Behaviour Insights Team’ has been established by the government to study how people can be encouraged, at minimum cost to the public purse, to live in what are considered to be socially desirable ways.
sentences.zh: 然而,沃森的简化模型现已被广泛应用,“行为改变”成为政府的目标：在英国,政府成立了一个“行为洞察小组”,研究如何以最小的公共财政成本鼓励人们以社会理想的方式生活。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Modern industrial societies appear to need the possibility of ever-increasing happiness to motivate them in their labours.
sentences.zh: 现代工业社会似乎需要不断增加的幸福感来激励他们的劳动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But whatever its intellectual pedigree, the idea that governments should be responsible for promoting happiness is always a threat to human freedom.
sentences.zh: 但无论其思想背景如何,政府应负责促进幸福的想法始终是对人类自由的威胁。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: * ‘behaviourism,: a branch of psychology which is concerned with observable behaviour
sentences.zh: *“行为主义,：心理学的一个分支,涉及可观察的行为

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。
